The error occurs because R8 code shrinking is enabled for the release build (`isMinifyEnabled = true`), which strips bytecode `Signature` attributes and generic type metadata by default. When Gson's `TypeToken` attempts to inspect its generic type arguments via reflection at runtime (`object : TypeToken<List<Book>>() {}.type`), the type parameters are missing and it throws:

```
java.lang.IllegalStateException: TypeToken must be created with a type argument: new TypeToken<...>() {}; When using code shrinkers (ProGuard, R8, ...) make sure that generic signatures are preserved.
```

### Changes Made

Updated [app/proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-A-r4/work/app/proguard-rules.pro#L1-L17) with the necessary ProGuard/R8 rules:

- Added `-keepattributes Signature, *Annotation*, EnclosingMethod, InnerClasses` to retain generic signatures and reflection metadata.
- Added `-keep class * extends com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken` and `-keep class com.google.gson.** { *; }` to prevent R8 from stripping or inlining `TypeToken` subclasses and their generic parameters.
- Added `-keep class vn.shelftap.lab.model.** { *; }` so model classes and their fields are preserved during Gson deserialization.
